candidats.titre: File:Former Tilling-Stevens Factory A Grade II Listed Building in Maidstone, Kent. Framed Photograph - 54411514778.jpg
candidats.description: Summary This former motor vehicle factory was built in 1917 by Wallis, Gilbert and Partners, in collaboration with Truscon, for Tilling-Stevens Ltd. It is an example of a factory designed using the Kahn Daylight System. The various sheds which adjoin the factory building to the south are not of special interest. Description The factory is constructed of a regular reinforced concrete grid, expressed throughout the exterior of the building; the front elevation, also of concrete, is dressed to present a classically-styled composition to the street. candidats.titre: File:Copped Hall kitchen walled garden, compost bin, Essex, England 1.jpg
candidats.description: A compost heap bin at the northwest of the walled garden, called 'The Kitchen Garden', 390 yards (360 m) northwest from Copped Hall , aka Copt Hall or Copthall, a Grade II listed country house , 1.5 miles (2 km) west from the town of Epping , Essex , England. The house and its ancillary buildings are within the civil parish of Epping Upland , with the larger part of the gardens to the west, in Waltham Abbey .
